# claude-kit

> A Composer dev package that sets up any Laravel project for Claude Code — and any AI coding agent — in one command. It scaffolds engineering rules (CLAUDE.md), a Stop-hook + pre-commit quality gate (PHPStan, Pint, Pest), reusable Claude Code skills, feature-doc templates, and stack-aware frontend tooling (Inertia+Vue, Inertia+React, Blade, or API-only). Install with `composer require --dev mohamed-ashraf-elsaed/claude-kit` then `php artisan claude-kit:install`.

Key facts:
- Language/framework: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 11/12/13.
- Package name (Packagist): mohamed-ashraf-elsaed/claude-kit
- License: MIT.
- The installer is interactive: choose Pint, PHPStan (+level, +Larastan, +strict, +an edit-time PostToolUse hook in block or warn mode), tests (+runner Pest/PHPUnit, +coverage, +architecture tests), architecture layers (Services/Repositories/Data Objects/Value Objects/Actions/Contracts — a declined layer gets no rule and no arch test), clean-code strictness (strict/balanced/relaxed), which hooks enforce the gate (Stop hook with N consecutive clean runs, git pre-commit, feature docs), read-only review agents (design-reviewer, docs-reviewer), workflow skills (/commit, /deploy, /dead-code, /codemap), always-on behavioural rules, a git-worktree rule, a concise output style, which skills to install (plus skills.sh discovery), and which extras to scaffold.
- Conventions are published as `.claude/rules/*.md` (path-scoped via `paths:` frontmatter where appropriate); CLAUDE.md stays short and carries an index of them. Authored conventions ship marked `<!-- DRAFT -->` for review.
- Hybrid updates: machinery lives in vendor/…/runtime/ (auto-updates via `composer update`); content is copied into the project (customisable). `php artisan claude-kit:update` re-publishes the copied content using per-file hashes recorded in `.claude/claude-kit.json` — untouched files are refreshed silently, edited files are never replaced without asking.
- Second command: `php artisan claude-kit:update` (re-publish previously selected stubs, preserving your edits).
